tabs.wait: The review of the changes is not available here yet.

switches.detailsOn: Details: on. Hide the explanations in plain words of the intent and the stories
switches.detailsOff: Details: off. Show the explanations in plain words of the intent and the stories
switches.helpOff: Explanations: off. Turn on the explanations of every part
switches.title: How to use {view}
switches.foot: *Details* turns the explanations in plain words of the intent and every story on or off. *?* turns these explanations on or off, with the explanations of the parts of the page.

text.play: Press *Play* and the steps run by themselves, or go on yourself with the arrows next to the step number. | With the keyboard: [Space], [←] and [→].
text.legend: *Legend* says what the colours and marks mean. *Only new and changed* leaves out what existed, *Full screen* gives the drawing all the room.

func.lead: Under the title is what the intent will do; *Read more* shows the rest. Below it the lifecycle of what it builds, the vertical slices and the integration tests.
func.leadBuilt: Under the title is what the intent built; *Read more* shows the rest. Below it the lifecycle of what it built, the vertical slices and the integration tests.
func.flow: In the lifecycle the numbers are the stories that build a step. A vertical slice is one story, from where it starts down to the tables; a line between two columns is a seam, and an integration test sits there.
func.flowBuilt: In the lifecycle the numbers are the stories that built a step. A vertical slice is one story, from where it starts down to the tables; a line between two columns is a seam, and an integration test sits there.
func.story: Click a story, a story number or a column for its details: why it is there, its criteria, its code and what it builds on. | Rest the mouse on a story and what it builds lights up. [←] and [→] go to the story before or after it, [Esc] closes the details.
func.storyBuilt: Click a story, a story number or a column for its details: why it is there, its criteria, its code and what it builds on. | Rest the mouse on a story and what it built lights up. [←] and [→] go to the story before or after it, [Esc] closes the details.
func.code: What the code will look like is under {flow}.
func.codeBuilt: How the code was built is under {flow}.
func.review: Every file the build changed is under {review}.
func.c4: Who and what the system touches is in the {c4}.

flow.lead: The starting point of the code:
flow.leadPlan: The plan of the code, with the change that is open:
flow.leadBuilt: The code as it was built:
flow.drawn: every part in its layer, every arrow a call. A flow begins at *Start* with its number and follows the arrows, step by step.
flow.story: Choose a story at the top and what it builds lights up. Click a part for what it does and where it is in the code; the details are on the right.
flow.marks: A coloured edge and a mark on the corner say where the build deviated from the starting point. Click such a part for what was planned, what it became and why.
flow.part: Click a part for what it does, what changed and which stories worked on it; the details are on the right. *View the change* opens the file under {review}.
flow.wrong: Is the drawing wrong? At the approval choose *The Code Scaffold is wrong* and say what has to change.

review.list: Every file the build changed, as in a merge request: the list on the left, on the right the chosen file with what it does, what changed and the change in the code.
review.find: Search by name or path, choose an order or filter on the kind of change and the story. A deviation from the design is a card with the file: planned, built and why. | [/] searches a file, [j] and [k] go to the next and the previous one.
review.seen: Tick *Viewed* and you go on to the next file you did not see yet. The link to the merge request opens the file there, once it exists.
review.flow: *View in the flow* shows the file as a part of the drawing under {flow}.

c4.zoomCode: You zoom in over four levels: system context, containers, components and code. The bar above the drawing shows where you are and takes you back.
c4.zoom: You zoom in over three levels: system context, containers and components. There is no code yet: it comes with the build. The bar above the drawing shows where you are and takes you back.
c4.into: Double-click a card to zoom into it, or choose it and click the magnifier on its corner. | [Esc] first lets go of what you chose, then goes a level back.
c4.card: Click a card for what it is, whom it talks to and which stories will work on it. A number on a card pins that story.
c4.cardBuilt: Click a card for what it is, whom it talks to and which stories worked on it. A number on a card pins that story.
c4.drag: Drag the drawing when it is larger than the window, or zoom with the buttons at the bottom right. | [+], [-] and [0] do that too.

review.nothingYet: After the build the changed files are listed here.
review.listWidth: Width of the list of files
review.listWidthTip: Drag to make the list wider or narrower (left or right arrow). Double-click for the usual width.
review.toFlowTip: Show this part in the drawing, on the Flow tab
review.mrStory: Open {name} in the merge request of story {n} in {host}
review.mrIntent: Open {name} in the merge request of the intent in {host}
review.notBuilt: No change in the code: this part was not built.
review.notUsed: No change in the code: this part was not used.
review.noFile: No change of this file on this page.
review.noDetails: The design says nothing about this file.
review.allTip: The whole change of this file
review.onlyStory: Only what story {n} did to this file
review.onlyStoryTitle: Only what story {n}: {title} did to this file
review.split: Divide the room between the details and the code
review.splitTip: Drag to give the details or the code more room (left or right arrow). Double-click for the usual split.
review.searchLabel: Search a file by name or path
review.searchTip: Search by name or path; * stands for any text (key /)

stepbox.label: The step
stepbox.headTip: Drag the step wherever you like. A double-click puts it back.

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.readTip: Back to readable, on the step (0)
zoom.toStart: To the start of the step
zoom.toEnd: To the end of the step

float.title: Details
float.headTip: Drag the details wherever you like. A double-click puts them back.

reasons.open: A choice is still open. You make it at the approval.
reasons.newFollows: New, and it follows an example in the code.
reasons.newOwn: New, with its own design: no example in the code does it the same way.
reasons.checked: Its place in the code was found and checked.
reasons.unchecked: Only the name is known. Its place in the code was not checked.
reasons.docs: Known only from documentation, not from the code.
reasons.doubt: But the agent has a doubt:

reasonsBuilt.open: At the design a choice was still open, to be made at the approval.
reasonsBuilt.newFollows: New, and it followed an example in the code.
reasonsBuilt.newOwn: New, with its own design: no example in the code did it the same way.
reasonsBuilt.checked: At the design its place in the code was found and checked.
reasonsBuilt.unchecked: At the design only the name was known. Its place in the code was not checked.
reasonsBuilt.docs: At the design it was known only from documentation, not from the code.
reasonsBuilt.doubt: But the agent had a doubt:

design.added: Built: the builder names it in the build notes, with its place in the code.

buildLine.changed: Code Scaffold: {different} different from the design, {extra} added{gone}

note.plan: This is the starting point of the code: roughly how it will be built. The build can differ in the details. You will see every difference on this drawing afterwards. A new permission, a new table or a new module is put to you first, before it is built.
note.built: This is how it was built. Where a part differs from the approved starting point, a coloured border and a mark on its corner show it: blue is different from the design, green is added, grey is not built or not used. Click such a part for what was planned, what it became and why.
note.open: A change is open. This drawing shows the plan, with that change in it, and not yet what was built. Review shows what is built already.

built.noReason: The build notes give no reason.

browse.nearKeys: to the block in that direction

goPart.prev: Go to the previous element: {name} (left arrow)
goPart.next: Go to the next element: {name} (right arrow)

goStep.prev: Go to the previous step: step {n} (left arrow)
goStep.next: Go to the next step: step {n} (right arrow)

detail.reviewTip: Open the change of {name} in Review

diff.noEol: No newline at the end of the file
diff.tooBig: Too large to show here: see this change in git.
diff.body: The change in {name}, line by line
diff.cutOne: Shortened: the last line of the change is not on this page.
diff.cutMany: Shortened: the last {n} lines of the change are not on this page.

one.plan: that already exists and does not change
one.built: that already existed and did not change

many.plan: that already exist and do not change
many.built: that already existed and did not change

legend.title: Legend
legend.rulesClick: Fixed rules, not the agent's feeling. Click a part for the reason.
legend.rulesTap: Fixed rules, not the agent's feeling. Tap a part for the reason.
legend.module: Module: the coloured label at the bottom of a part
legend.differsLong: Differs from the example in the code

asks.title: Is this wrong?
asks.redraw: The agent changes the plan and draws it again, before anything is built.

mode.label: Flow or review
mode.flowTip: Follow the flow: go a step back or forward (left or right arrow) or play the steps (space). On the right you see where each step goes. Stays on until you choose Review
mode.reviewTip: Look at the parts one by one (left or right arrow); with a block in focus the arrows go to the block in that direction. Space plays the steps. Stays on until you choose Flow

pane.grip: Drag to make the panel wider or narrower
pane.gripTip: Drag to make the panel wider or narrower (left or right arrow). Double-click for the usual width.

panel.choose: Choose a story to see what it builds.
panel.chooseBuilt: Choose a story to see what it built.
panel.actClick: Click a part for its place in the code.
panel.actTap: Tap a part or an arrow for the details.
panel.openClick: Open the drawing and click a part for its place in the code.
panel.openTap: Open the drawing and tap a part or an arrow for the details.
panel.tall: Does not fit on one screen: open it full screen.

pick.part: Choose another element (up or down arrow)
pick.module: Choose an element of this module (up or down arrow)

play.playTip: Play the steps, one by one (space)

steps.prev: Go to the previous step (left arrow)
steps.next: Go to the next step (right arrow)

stories.unfold: Show the user story of story {n}
stories.region: The stories of what you chose

view.label: {title} full screen
view.side: Show or hide the legend and the explanation
view.zoomFieldTip: Type a percentage and press Enter
view.tip: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
view.tipTouch: Drag to pan, pinch to zoom.

overview.title: Intent overview
overview.lifecycleAria: Lifecycle of {subject}, with the stories per step
overview.seamOpen: seam without a planned integration test
overview.toTests: How these seams are tested is under Integration tests below
overview.toTestsBuilt: How these seams were tested is under Integration tests below
overview.testsAria: Integration tests between the stories, per build step
overview.testsKey: Each arrow is one test, from the earlier story to the story that holds the test.
overview.noClasses: The test plan does not name the classes.
overview.noExpect: Not listed apart in the test plan, see what the test does.
overview.whenAfter: when story {later} is built, story {earlier} is already done
overview.whenAfterBuilt: when story {later} was built, story {earlier} was already done
overview.whenWith: when story {later} is built, together with story {earlier}
overview.whenWithBuilt: story {later} was built together with story {earlier}
overview.prevTitle: Go to the previous story (left arrow)
overview.nextTitle: Go to the next story (right arrow)

explain.flow: The life of {subject}; the numbers are the stories that build a step.
explain.slices: A vertical slice is one story: one working piece, from where it starts (a screen or a scheduled job) down to the tables. Read a column top to bottom; the columns are in the order they are built in.
explain.slicesLink: A line between two columns is a seam: a later story uses or changes something an earlier story made or changed. That is exactly where an integration test sits, see Integration tests below.
explain.slicesPhone: A vertical slice is one story: one working piece, from where it starts (a screen or a scheduled job) down to the tables. Read each story top to bottom; the stories are in the order they are built in.
explain.slicesLinkPhone: A part marked "builds on story" is a seam: a later story uses or changes something an earlier story made or changed. That is exactly where an integration test sits, see Integration tests below.
explain.tests: An integration test sits in a later story and runs against the real code of an earlier story, never against a stub. That proves the two stories work together, not only each on its own.

cell.usesTip: the story relies on it, but does not change it

context.built: Who and what this intent touched: the people, the system and the systems around it, and how they talk to each other.
context.plan: Who and what this intent will touch: the people, the system and the systems around it, and how they talk to each other.

caption.containers: The containers of the system, and what hangs on it from outside.

components.built: The components in {name} that this intent built or touched, and who they talk to.
components.plan: The components in {name} that this intent will build or touch, and who they talk to.

caption.code: The classes and scripts in {name}, and who they talk to. Every line is a call that was checked in the code.

drawing.wait: The drawing is being laid out.
drawing.failed: The drawing could not be laid out. Reload the page.

build.noReason: The build notes give no reason.
build.note: After the build, in this drawing: {counts}. A file that differs from the approved design has a coloured border and a sign on its corner: blue is different from the design, green is added, grey is not built or not used. Review lists every deviation, also of files outside the drawing.
build.planOpen: A change is open. This drawing shows the plan with that change in it, not yet what was built.

notice.onlyTests: Story {n} only wrote tests and touches nothing in the model.
notice.nothingHere: Story {n} touches nothing in this drawing.
notice.allOne: Story {n} touches {elements} here; it lies further {where}.
notice.allMany: Story {n} touches {elements} here; they lie further {where}.
notice.someOne: Story {n} touches {elements} here; {k} of them lies further {where}.
notice.someMany: Story {n} touches {elements} here; {k} of them lie further {where}.

panel.clickOne: Click one to look at it.
panel.keys: [Enter] or a double click zooms in, [Esc] goes back a level, [+] and [-] zoom the drawing. When the drawing is larger than the window, drag it.
panel.source: Made from the code of this intent. Every line between components and classes is summed from calls that were checked in the code.
panel.nothingTests: Nothing in the model: this story only wrote tests, as proof that the chain works.

lit.built: The drawing lights up what this story touched. Click the story again to let it go.
lit.plan: The drawing lights up what this story will touch. Click the story again to let it go.

side.title: Details
side.gripTip: Drag to make the details wider or narrower; past the narrowest they fold; double-click for the usual width
